headline: Update on the FY 2028 City Budget and process, plus gallery exhibit news and a Jambo dedication recap.
summary: Draft minutes from October 20, 2026 are up for review. Gallery plans include the SNOW winter exhibit and an artist show on December 6, and the agenda includes a moment to share about John Killacky, a former member.
